source.title: Safe, efficient and selective synthesis of dinitro herbicides via a multifunctional continuous-flow microreactor: one-step dinitration with nitric acid as agent

batch_reference.sequence: dilute HNO3, phase separation, concentrated HNO3

evidence: PDF page 3, selected conditions and one-hour stability run

corpus_correction: The corpus record reports 9 s for the optimized design, but Table 1 entry 8 and the selected-condition paragraph report 0.8 s at 13.8 mL/min. The original PDF controls.
interpretation: The published conditions are a validated reference, not the only permissible valid screen. Universal validity and source distance are scored separately. Direct one-step dinitration remains a hazardous screen requiring low holdup and thermal-risk review.
